function: Excluded (system): AirComp weighted averaging for distributed regression and federated averaging over a scalar fading channel, single antenna, no RIS (p. 4).
notes: Read as AirComp aggregation for distributed learning, checks 1-5 pass: the contribution is an adaptive weight-truncation AirComp whose two parameters are tuned by Bayesian optimization (pp. 6-7), applied to distributed Gaussian process regression for radio maps (pp. 9-14) and to FedAvg model aggregation (p. 15, listed as a contribution on p. 2), so area 7 by function, with quantitative results (Figs. 9-13). Exclusion is system: the received signal is a sum of sqrt(gamma_i) h_i x_i plus noise with a scalar gain h_i, AWGN or i.i.d. Rayleigh (p. 4), M nodes connected to one BS (p. 3), and neither the system model nor Table II (p. 10) has an antenna array or RIS; MIMO and RIS appear only in the related work (p. 3). The paper never writes 'single antenna'; the scalar model implies it. Doubts for the reviewer: no_learning would apply if the Bayesian optimization of two parameters and the distributed regression application are not counted as learning, with federated learning only a case study (p. 15); function would apply if radio map construction is taken as the function. The decision is exclude in all three readings.
